pages.observation: The 'us' in the first caption has no clear owner (Ravi, the clinic or a narrator). The shift to an imagined future is not clearly set apart from the present-day story. The specialist, partner and child appear without any introduction. The 'WELBUK VISION' label appears twice in a row, which is redundant. The top-right caption box nearly touches the specialist face box, with only a few pixels between them. The final panel has a large empty band between the label and the faces. No reader-thanks text is present. Every line is legible.
